raw.description:
Role Title: Military Writing Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (US Only)

micro1 is engaging Military Writing Specialists to support a unique project, leveraging expertise in military writing and reporting. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Contributors will use their background in Department of War (Department of Defense) documentation to generate, review, and evaluate a wide range of reports, summaries, and status updates reflective of authentic military processes. Your input will help develop benchmarks and grading guidelines that will teach AI to understand and replicate effective, compliant government communication.

Scope of Work

  1. Create realistic military and federal status reports, summaries, and executive updates based on prompts and supplied artifacts.
  2. Develop “golden responses” that demonstrate high-quality, standards-aligned reporting for use in AI model training.
  3. Draft grading rubrics and guidelines that reflect best practices in federal and military writing assessment.
  4. Evaluate AI-generated reports, providing detailed feedback in both written and verbal form.
  5. Share context on stylistic differences and individual approaches to common military documents (e.g., WARs, SITREPs, AARs, executive summaries).
  6. Produce supporting documents such as decision briefs, memoranda, and action officer updates when required.
  7. Collaborate with other subject matter experts to ensure diversity of reporting styles and adherence to branch-specific terminology.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Former U.S. Department of War (Department of Defense) professional with at least 3 years of relevant experience.
  2. Experience producing templated and standard reports such as Weekly Activity Reports (WARs), Situation Reports (SITREPs), After-Action Reviews, or similar artifacts.
  3. Expertise spanning two or more branches of the U.S. military is a plus; a diverse background across roles is highly valued.
  4. Proven proficiency in written and verbal communication, particularly in conveying technical or operational subject matter.
  5. Demonstrated ability to craft, grade, and review back office documents, PowerPoints, memos, and spreadsheets for military or federal purposes.
  6. US-based contributor with broad familiarity with federal documentation standards and compliance best practices.
  7. Comfortable collaborating remotely and sharing insights on nuanced, highly procedural reporting tasks.

raw.description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Remote Senior Interior Architectural Drafterto lead the development of highly detailed, coordinated, and construction-ready interior architectural drawing sets for complex projects. This senior-level position requires extensive expertise in interior construction, custom millwork, framing, finish applications, and technical detailing, with the ability to translate design concepts into accurate, buildable solutions. The ideal candidate will have 8–10+ years of architectural or interior architectural drafting experience, advanced proficiency in AutoCAD and SketchUp, and strong knowledge of Revit. The role requires a comprehensive understanding of construction documentation, technical coordination, and industry standards, along with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. The successful candidate will work independently while collaborating closely with designers, architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, fabricators, and other project stakeholders in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development of comprehensive interior architectural drawing sets.
  • Produce highly detailed plans, elevations, sections, reflected ceiling plans, schedules, and construction details.
  • Develop detailed drawings for custom millwork, cabinetry, paneling, built-ins, ceilings, stairs, fireplaces, doors, and specialty interior features.
  • Prepare detailed wall, floor, ceiling, and finish transitions.
  • Document interior framing, blocking, substrates, attachment methods, clearances, and finish applications.
  • Translate complex design concepts into technically sound and buildable solutions.
  • Review architectural, structural, MEP, lighting, and vendor drawings for coordination with the interior design.
  • Identify constructability issues, drawing conflicts, and missing information before drawings are issued.
  • Coordinate technical details directly with contractors, fabricators, millworkers, and specialty vendors.
  • Review shop drawings and submittals for design intent, dimensions, materials, and coordination.
  • Establish and maintain high drafting and documentation standards.
  • Guide and review the work of intermediate and junior drafting staff.
  • Support the design team with technical recommendations throughout design development and construction.
  • Perform other duties related to the position as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Proficient level of English (written and spoken).
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • 8–10+ years of architectural or interior architectural drafting experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD and SketchUp with strong knowledge of Revit.
  • Extensive experience preparing detailed, construction-ready interior drawing sets.
  • Expert knowledge of custom millwork, cabinetry, interior framing, finish carpentry, and finish applications.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, substrates, tolerances, attachment methods, and material transitions.
  • Experience coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and fabricators.
  • Ability to independently resolve complex technical and constructability issues.
  • Strong knowledge of applicable building codes and industry standards.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and drawing coordination.
  • Degree in architecture, interior architecture, architectural technology, or a related field is strongly preferred.
  • Architectural licensure is valued but not required.
  • Strong organization, time management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and follow established processes.
  • Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new systems and workflows.
  • Professional, dependable, coachable, and accountable with excellent attendance.
  • Creative, resourceful, and proactive with an out-of-the-box mindset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), and standard business tools (email, spreadsheets, document management).
  • Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time (New York) business hours and adapt to business needs.
  • Interested in long-term career opportunities.
  • Reliable computer (Windows 10 or newer), two monitors, and stable high-speed internet.﻿
  • Professional home workstation capable of supporting uninterrupted remote work.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • 100% remote work.
  • Compensation in USD.
  • Full-time position with 40 hours weekly.
  • Please note that this is a long-term opportunity.
  • Great work environment with potential for growth.

We're looking for an experienced, motivated Staff Technical Program Manager to oversee high visibility programs for our team and streamline our processes for building great customer and merchant products. As our products scale in complexity to meet our accelerating business and expanding product lines, our program management practices need to scale with it. You will help our Product and Engineering teams develop processes and frameworks for building quality software, while evaluating new technology developments to drive potential features and products.

What you'll do

  • Drive complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible technical programs in service of our team’s mission of expanding our consumer product suite and platform capabilities.

  • Coordinate across engineering teams and non-engineering stakeholders through the full program lifecycle to plan requirements, identify risks, manage program schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.

  • Understand technical implementation at the architecture level and propose technical alternatives, ask questions that clarify priorities and push the team to be effective, and develop domain and technical knowledge.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to plan requirements, identify risks, manage program schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.

  • Track progress, resolve dependencies, evaluate risks, and communicate status to upper management and program stakeholders, and engage the program teams to achieve goals.

What we look for

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8 years of proven experience managing technical programs.

  • Passion and drive to change consumer finance for the better.

  • Organized and strategic approach to collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams.

  • Obsesses over getting the details right but knows how to ship on time.

  • Working and driving strategic programs and building a remote friendly culture.

  • Actively mentors and levels up team members.

  • Track record of successfully driving complex large technology applications and geographically distributed backend systems.

  • Track record of strong stakeholder management with Engineering, Product, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams.

  • Prior experience in FinTech, Payments or Commerce is a plus.

Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $153,000 - $213,000

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
  • ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

Role Title: Mechanical Engineer - AI trainer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is selecting experienced Mechanical Engineer - AI trainers to contribute to a customer project focused on developing advanced AI systems for engineering applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Produce detailed 3D CAD models of simple mechanical components using platforms such as SolidWorks, NX, Creo, or CATIA.
  2. Interpret and analyze technical drawings, identifying critical dimensions, tolerances, and specifications.
  3. Document component requirements, technical specifications, and manufacturing tolerances in clear, structured formats.
  4. Contribute insights and feedback on conceptual stress analysis and finite element analysis (FEA) tasks, supporting model validation.
  5. Review, critique, and enhance technical documentation and CAD outputs for accuracy and clarity.
  6. Provide expert written and verbal feedback to help train and validate AI system outputs in the context of mechanical engineering.
  7. Collaborate asynchronously with cross-functional teams via remote communication tools, ensuring project objectives are achieved.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 5+ years of demonstrated, hands-on experience in mechanical design engineering, with a focus on 3D CAD modeling and FEA.
  2. Proficiency in SolidWorks, NX, Creo, or CATIA, with a strong preference for contributors with multi-platform expertise.
  3. Proven ability to interpret and produce comprehensive technical drawings and documentation.
  4. Deep conceptual understanding of stress analysis, FEA principles, and engineering validation processes.
  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; meticulous attention to detail in documentation.
  6. Experience as a design engineer modeling components, interpreting drawings, and defining requirements.
  7. Knowledge of end-to-end engineering processes from requirements definition through to validation and documentation.

Vice President of Sales

Company: Interdependence Location: Remote (US, any time zone) Reports to:Chairman/FounderCompensation: $250,000–$300,000 OTE

WHO WE ARE

The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month.

Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for — and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result.

Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment.

We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring our first Vice President of Sales. The team has grown beyond what the Chairman can directly manage, and we need a leader to step in, build structure, and scale what's working.

You'll directly manage the account executives, a mix of seasoned closers and newly promoted reps. AEs focus on demoing and closing inbound and BDR-sourced opportunities; they don't self-source. Deals run a 30–90 day cycle with $100K–$200K ACVs, and the team operates on a monthly quota.

This is a builder's seat. You'll inherit a working motion and be expected to professionalize it: tighter forecasting, MEDDICC discipline across every deal, repeatable seller onboarding, and the operating cadence that gets a fast-growing team to predictable monthly attainment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage and develop 7-10 AEs with focused attention on ramping newly promoted reps to full productivity
  • Own monthly quota attainment and pipeline coverage
  • Continue to optimize and document the sales process from discovery through close
  • Run weekly 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and listening sessions
  • Operationalize MEDDICC/MEDDPICC across the team and inspect deals rigorously
  • Partner with revenue operations, BDR leadership and client services on lead quality, messaging, and handoffs
  • Build new hire onboarding and ongoing enablement
  • Forecast accurately and report directly to the Chairman
  • Have a ready network of seasoned sales talent ready to join the team.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of front-line sales management experience, ideally at a fast-growing company- bias towards action is key here
  • Mid-market and enterprise sales background with a track record of success in full quota carrying and management capacity
  • MEDDICC or MEDDPICC trained, with experience rolling it out across a team
  • Experience managing both veteran AEs and earlier-career AEs
  • A track record of taking a sales motion from "working" to "repeatable" — process design, playbooks, onboarding
  • Comfort with sub-90-day sales cycles and a high-velocity monthly cadence
  • An AI forward mindset
  • Salesforce, , Attention, Claude, Chat GPT

NICE TO HAVE

  • Agency, PR, or professional services sales experience
  • Experience selling to marketing and communications leaders
  • Background scaling a sales team through an inflection point

BENEFITS

  • $250K–$450K OTE with a 50/50 base/variable split

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE

🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the U.S. while enjoying the flexibility of a fully remote workplace. Skip the commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth.

🩺 Comprehensive Health Benefits - Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being.

💰 Retirement Savings - Save for the future with our 401(k) program, including a company match that is increasing to 3% by 2027.

🌴 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, 11 company holidays, a floating holiday, and Summer Fridays to recharge and spend more time doing what you love.

👶 Paid Maternity Leave - We support growing families with paid maternity leave, giving new moms dedicated time to recover, bond with their baby, and return to work with confidence.

📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing PR and strategic communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with real impact.

🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed.

Interdependence is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

WHO WE ARE

The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month.

Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for — and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result.

Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment.

We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring our first Vice President of Sales. The team has grown beyond what the Chairman can directly manage, and we need a leader to step in, build structure, and scale what's working.

You'll directly manage the account executives, a mix of seasoned closers and newly promoted reps. AEs focus on demoing and closing inbound and BDR-sourced opportunities; they don't self-source. Deals run a 30–90 day cycle with $100K–$200K ACVs, and the team operates on a monthly quota.

This is a builder's seat. You'll inherit a working motion and be expected to professionalize it: tighter forecasting, MEDDICC discipline across every deal, repeatable seller onboarding, and the operating cadence that gets a fast-growing team to predictable monthly attainment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage and develop 7-10 AEs with focused attention on ramping newly promoted reps to full productivity
  • Own monthly quota attainment and pipeline coverage
  • Continue to optimize and document the sales process from discovery through close
  • Run weekly 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and listening sessions
  • Operationalize MEDDICC/MEDDPICC across the team and inspect deals rigorously
  • Partner with revenue operations, BDR leadership and client services on lead quality, messaging, and handoffs
  • Build new hire onboarding and ongoing enablement
  • Forecast accurately and report directly to the Chairman
  • Have a ready network of seasoned sales talent ready to join the team.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of front-line sales management experience, ideally at a fast-growing company- bias towards action is key here
  • Mid-market and enterprise sales background with a track record of success in full quota carrying and management capacity
  • MEDDICC or MEDDPICC trained, with experience rolling it out across a team
  • Experience managing both veteran AEs and earlier-career AEs
  • A track record of taking a sales motion from "working" to "repeatable" — process design, playbooks, onboarding
  • Comfort with sub-90-day sales cycles and a high-velocity monthly cadence
  • An AI forward mindset
  • Salesforce, , Attention, Claude, Chat GPT

NICE TO HAVE

  • Agency, PR, or professional services sales experience
  • Experience selling to marketing and communications leaders
  • Background scaling a sales team through an inflection point

BENEFITS

  • $250K–$450K OTE with a 50/50 base/variable split

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE

🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the U.S. while enjoying the flexibility of a fully remote workplace. Skip the commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth.

🩺 Comprehensive Health Benefits - Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being.

💰 Retirement Savings - Save for the future with our 401(k) program, including a company match that is increasing to 3% by 2027.

🌴 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, 11 company holidays, a floating holiday, and Summer Fridays to recharge and spend more time doing what you love.

👶 Paid Maternity Leave - We support growing families with paid maternity leave, giving new moms dedicated time to recover, bond with their baby, and return to work with confidence.

📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing PR and strategic communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with real impact.

🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed.

Interdependence is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

You will support end-to-end recruiting for A1’s product, engineering, and business roles.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will work closely with recruiters and hiring managers to keep hiring moving smoothly and accurately. It’s a good fit for someone early in their career who wants to learn how high-quality technical hiring actually works in practice.

What you will be doing

  • Support the full recruitment process across roles, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and offer support.

  • Source candidates through a mix of channels, including LinkedIn, referrals, job boards, and proactive outreach.

  • Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate screens to assess basic role fit, motivation, and communication.

  • Coordinate interviews, scheduling, and feedback collection with candidates and hiring managers.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in the ATS, ensuring data quality and process consistency.

  • Support recruiting projects and process improvements as the team scales, including candidate experience and employer branding initiatives.

  • Help keep hiring operations organised, responsive, and moving at pace.

What you will need

  • 0–2 years of experience in recruiting, HR, operations, coordination, or related roles
    (fresh graduates with a strong interest in recruiting are welcome).

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfort working with tools such as Google Sheets / Excel and basic ATS systems.

  • A proactive, learning-oriented mindset and openness to feedback.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through reliably.

(Prior recruiting experience is helpful but not required. Attitude, curiosity, and execution matter more.)

Why join A1

  • Learn technical recruiting from the ground up in a small, high-bar team.

  • Work closely with experienced recruiters, engineers, and hiring managers.

  • Hands-on ownership and real responsibility from day one.

  • Flat structure where initiative and execution matter more than titles.

  • Clear growth path into Talent Partner, Recruiter, or specialised technical hiring roles.

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful career development.

Role Title: Data Entry Keyer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Data Entry Keyers to contribute to a customer's advanced AI benchmark project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Scope of Work

  4. Author detailed grading rubrics (35+ criteria) for assessment of AI agent outputs, focusing on both accuracy and completeness in error detection.

Preferred Qualifications

  3. Strong skills in detecting and analyzing data inconsistencies, silent truncations, and formatting irregularities across diverse file types.
  4. Proficient written English, enabling clear drafting of complex evaluation tasks and comprehensive grading rubrics.
  5. Exceptional attention to detail and a disciplined, process-oriented work style.
  6. Experience contributing to projects with high stakes for compliance, accuracy, or data integrity is highly valued.
  7. Comfort working independently and communicating proactively within remote, distributed project environments.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

We're running a paid study on clinical decision-making for patients with asthma and chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP). This research aims to map out current treatment pathways and understand how specialists evaluate different therapeutic options. Your input will help us establish a clearer picture of real-world clinical practices for these respiratory conditions.

How It Works

You will participate in a 45-minute remote survey from your computer. The session consists primarily of multiple-choice questions detailing various clinical scenarios and treatment choices. You will also be prompted to provide spoken answers to a few voice-response questions to elaborate on your clinical reasoning. This format allows you to walk us through your typical workflow when managing complex respiratory cases.

Who This Is For

We are hiring practicing specialist physicians based in the United States who regularly treat respiratory conditions. We welcome specialists in Allergy and Immunology, Pulmonology, and Otolaryngology (ENT). Candidates should be comfortable discussing their direct clinical experience managing asthma and CRSwNP.

What You'll Do

  • Complete a 45-minute remote research survey

  • Evaluate clinical scenarios related to asthma and CRSwNP

  • Select appropriate treatment pathways through multiple-choice questions

  • Explain your clinical reasoning using brief voice recordings

Who Should Apply

  • Practicing specialist physician in the United States

  • Specialization in Allergy and Immunology, Pulmonology, or ENT

We're looking for a detail-oriented, execution-focused Senior Marketplace PPC Associate, to support day-to-day paid media management across Amazon Ads and our growing retail media footprint. This role is essential to keeping our paid media engine running cleanly as we scale spend, add new retail partners, and bring PPC management fully in-house. This role reports into our Marketplace PPC & Performance Marketing Manager.

If you're organized, fast-moving, and energized by hands-on optimization work, this is a role built for someone ready to run marketplace performance with real ownership.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL + plus conference travel where applicable to keep you sharp on the industry.

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Director of Developer Experience, you will be tasked with leading the organization responsible for how every engineer at the company builds, tests, ships, and operates software. You will own two interconnected functions: Infrastructure Services (CI/CD orchestration, GitOps continuous delivery, artifact management, and related platforms) and Developer Tooling (the teams that design and operate our CI/CD pipelines and internal developer platform). Critically, you will also define and execute our strategy for integrating AI across the software development lifecycle, from AI-assisted code generation and review to AI-driven engineering intelligence platforms.

Developer experience is one of the highest-leverage investments an engineering organization can make, and AI is the largest shift in how software is built in a generation. The Director of Developer Experience will directly shape how hundreds of engineers spend their day, how quickly we ship, how confidently we operate in production, and how effectively we harness AI across the SDLC. This is a critically important role with executive visibility and a clear mandate to deliver measurable results.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Lead, grow, and develop a multi-team organization of managers and senior engineers spanning Infrastructure Services and Developer Tooling.
  • Define and execute the vision for developer experience, including build, test, deployment, artifact management, internal platform capabilities, and AI-augmented developer workflows.
  • Own the strategy and rollout of AI tooling across the SDLC, including AI coding assistants, AI code review and PR automation, AI-assisted test generation, and AI engineering intelligence platforms. Drive adoption, measure impact, and ensure these tools are deployed safely and effectively.
  • Ensure the availability, performance, and security of the systems that engineers depend on every day.
  • Drive the evolution of CI/CD pipelines to be faster, more reliable, more self-service, and more secure, including embedding AI capabilities such as automated triage, intelligent test selection, and AI-assisted incident response.
  • Establish metrics and use them to drive measurable improvement in developer productivity.
  • Partner with security, legal, and AI leadership to set policy for AI-generated code, IP and licensing, data handling, model selection, and acceptable-use guardrails.
  • Partner with security, SRE, product engineering, architecture, and AI/ML teams to align on standards, golden paths, and shared platforms.
  • Own the budget, tooling investments, and vendor relationships for the developer experience portfolio, including AI tooling spend.
  • Recruit, mentor, and retain exceptional engineering leaders and individual contributors.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

raw.description:
Finance Transformation Manager — M-KOPA

You know the difference between a demo and a system that survives contact with a trial balance. That's rarer than you think.

Most people who can talk fluently about AI have never had to make it work inside a real close process, a real audit trail, a real Anaplan model that finance actually trusts. M-KOPA is looking for someone who has — or someone ready to prove they can.

Where this sits. M-KOPA is one of Africa's fastest-growing fintechs, now serving 7 million customers across five markets and having unlocked over $2 billion in credit. Behind those numbers is a finance function running on Microsoft Dynamics and Anaplan, increasingly threaded through with Claude, and a leadership team that's decided this is the moment to stop treating AI as an experiment and start treating it as infrastructure.

Why now. We've grown from 5 million customers to 7 million, and we're building toward 10 million next. That growth doesn't just need more finance headcount — it needs a finance function that runs leaner and smarter than the one that got us here. 86% of our customers report improved quality of life, and 70% use our products to generate income; the systems behind those numbers need to scale without the manual reconciliation and reporting drag that usually comes with scale. This role exists because our leadership has committed to closing that gap now, not after it becomes a bottleneck.

What makes this different. Most "finance transformation" roles are really change-management roles wearing a technical label — you'll sit in workshops, write recommendations, and hand them to someone else to build. This one isn't that. You'll sit inside the finance team, find the friction yourself, and build the fix yourself: deepening our Claude–Dynamics integration, designing agents and workflows that actually replace manual reconciliation work, and owning the result end to end. It's a builder's mandate with a finance brief, not an IT ticket queue.

What you'll bring.

  • Demonstrable experience deploying Claude (or a comparable AI system) in a real business context — prompt design, workflow automation, API integration, and artefacts that actually run in production. This is the single most important thing we're looking for, and we'll ask you to show us something real you've built, ideally involving a Dynamics-style integration.

  • A technical foundation strong enough to read a data model and a trial balance in the same afternoon, paired with exceptional learning aptitude — the proven ability to apply AI and engineering thinking to genuinely complex financial and accounting scenarios.

  • Working knowledge of how audit actually works in practice: mining and structuring data for external and internal audit processes, and following through on remediation of findings, not just producing the report.

What the work looks like. Some weeks you're deep in the weeds of a Dynamics-Anaplan integration, chasing down why two systems disagree on a number. Other weeks you're building an agent that turns a two-day reconciliation into a two-hour one, then coaching the finance team on when to trust it and when not to. You'll be the person finance calls when something's slow, and the person engineering calls when they need someone who actually understands what a close process demands. Data integrity — one source of truth across the finance stack — sits with you.

Reality check. This role asks you to be genuinely bilingual between finance and engineering, and there's no playbook to hand you — you'll be writing it as you go, often while systems are live and numbers are due. If that sounds like friction rather than freedom, this probably isn't the role. If it sounds like exactly the kind of problem you've been waiting for someone to hand you, you're probably ready for it.

Where you work from. This role is remote or based in any of our operating markets — we're more interested in what you can build than where you build it from.

If you've spent the last while wondering why finance teams still work the way they did a decade ago, and you've actually built something that proves it doesn't have to — let's talk about what that could look like at M-KOPA scale.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

raw.description:
What We're Researching

We are running a paid study on how public-facing experts gather information and stay informed on emerging issues. This research helps us understand the shifting landscape of knowledge distribution and trusted sourcing. Your insights will inform how we evaluate professional information-gathering habits across various fields.

How It Works

You will complete a short remote survey detailing your professional experience and information workflows. The survey asks you to walk through the sources you trust, how you verify facts, and the ways you share knowledge with your audience. You will react to different scenarios regarding emerging issues and explain your typical engagement strategies. The entire process is asynchronous and designed to be completed quickly on your own schedule.

Who This Is For

We are looking for influential professionals who actively shape public understanding or community discourse. We welcome educators, media professionals, nonprofit leaders, cultural institution directors, researchers, and community organizers. Ideal candidates regularly consume, synthesize, and distribute information to broader audiences in their daily work.

What You'll Do

  • Complete an asynchronous remote survey about your professional workflows

  • Detail how you access, verify, and engage with emerging issues

  • Describe the information sources you rely on most heavily in your field

  • Explain how you share synthesized knowledge with your community or audience

Who Should Apply

  • Current role in education, media, nonprofit, research, or community leadership

  • Experience synthesizing and distributing information to a broader audience

  • Comfortable discussing your professional strategies for staying informed

  • Ability to complete a detailed, asynchronous written survey

Compensation

$49 one-time

Ready to participate?

Start your paid interview now

About Terac

Terac is building the world's largest pool of vetted human experts for AI. Researchers, AI labs, and product teams use Terac to recruit, screen, and pay study participants across industries, languages, and skill sets.

Learn more at or on YouTube at @jointerac.

raw.excerpt: We are looking for a Senior Lead - Shared Services to join our Human Resources group; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.
raw.description:
We are looking for a Senior Lead - Shared Services to join our Human Resources group; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

Job Purpose

The Senior Lead – HR Shared Services is responsible for overseeing the delivery of efficient, accurate, and compliant HR operational services across the employee lifecycle. The role supports global and market-level HR operations, including employee records management, contracts administration, payroll input coordination, offboarding, and employee relations case administration.

The position drives operational excellence through strong service governance, stakeholder management, risk controls, and continuous process improvement while ensuring consistent delivery against agreed service standards and SLAs.

Key Responsibilities

1. Service Delivery Leadership & Governance

  • Oversee day-to-day HR Shared Services operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of activities across the employee lifecycle.

  • Coordinate workload allocation, prioritisation, and operational follow-through across the function.

  • Establish and maintain operational routines, service standards, and process handoffs.

  • Track and report service KPIs including SLA adherence, turnaround times, quality metrics, backlog management, and error rates.

  • Manage escalations, resolve operational bottlenecks, and ensure timely communication and case closure.

2. Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Coordination

  • Partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and HRIS teams to deliver seamless HR operational support.

  • Align stakeholders on timelines, approvals, documentation standards, and service expectations.

  • Translate policy or business changes into operational processes, templates, communications, and training materials.

  • Provide operational updates, risk reporting, and improvement recommendations to People leadership where required.

3. Records & Data Governance

  • Ensure employee records and documentation are complete, accurate, and compliant with internal and regulatory requirements.

  • Conduct regular audits to identify and resolve data inconsistencies or compliance gaps.

  • Maintain confidentiality and strong controls around employee data handling and storage.

  • Drive HR data quality initiatives and implement preventive controls to minimise recurring errors.

4. Contracts & Employment Lifecycle Administration

  • Oversee employment contract issuance, renewals, amendments, and extensions within established timelines.

  • Ensure all employee documentation is accurately maintained within HR systems and document repositories.

  • Manage probation administration processes including confirmations, extensions, and related approvals.

  • Support performance management cycle administration, including documentation, letters, approvals tracking, and records management.

  • Ensure compliance with approval workflows, documentation standards, and record retention requirements.

5. Payroll Input Coordination

  • Coordinate monthly payroll input readiness by managing timelines, approvals, and submission requirements.

  • Oversee preparation and validation of payroll-related inputs, including commissions, bonuses, and employee lifecycle changes.

  • Investigate payroll discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions with Payroll and Finance stakeholders.

  • Maintain audit-ready payroll documentation and supporting controls.

6. Offboarding Operations

  • Coordinate smooth employee offboarding processes, including exit documentation, systems updates, benefits cessation, and stakeholder handoffs.

  • Ensure offboarding activities are completed accurately and within required timelines.

  • Manage escalations and exceptions to minimise operational risk and maintain a positive employee experience.

7. Employee Relations Case Administration

  • Oversee administration of disciplinary and grievance cases, including documentation, scheduling, minutes, milestone tracking, and outcome communication.

  • Maintain secure and confidential employee relations records in line with company policies and compliance requirements.

  • Support maintenance of ER templates, SOPs, and operational guidance documentation.

  • Coordinate timely follow-up and closure of employee relations cases.

8. Continuous Improvement & Operational Controls

  • Identify operational inefficiencies and implement practical process improvements, templates, and standardisation initiatives.

  • Support process mapping, SOP documentation, and operational training activities.

  • Strengthen operational controls relating to approvals, documentation, segregation of duties, and audit readiness.

  • Drive adoption of process enhancements and ensure operational consistency across the function.

9. Data Analytics, Reporting & AI Enablement

  • Analyse operational service data to identify trends, bottlenecks, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Develop and maintain dashboards covering SLA performance, service quality, payroll exceptions, and case management metrics.

  • Partner with HRIS and People Systems teams to support automation and AI-enabled HR operations initiatives.

  • Ensure AI-enabled processes comply with data privacy, governance, and documentation standards.

  • Use operational insights to support decision-making and improve employee experience outcomes.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Head of HR Shared Services

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

Professional Certification

  • Certified HR Practitioner in Ghana, preferably CIHRM

Experience

  • 4–5 years’ experience in HR Shared Services, HR Operations, or employee lifecycle administration roles.

  • Hands-on experience across HR records management, contracts administration, payroll coordination, offboarding, and employee relations support.

  • Experience working within fast-paced or multi-country operational environments is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of HR operations, compliance requirements, and employee lifecycle processes.

  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills.

  • Close attention to detail with strong risk awareness and control discipline.

  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities with experience using operational metrics to drive improvements.

  • Experience supporting automation, process improvement, or AI-enabled HR operational initiatives.

  • Strong communication, escalation management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work within tight deadlines.

  • Experience using HRIS systems such as HiBob or equivalent platforms is preferred.

  • Familiarity with ticketing or case management systems such as Freshservice is an advantage.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

raw.excerpt: About the RoleThis role sits at the intersection of robotics and data infrastructure at a well-funded, early-stage robotics company.
raw.description:
About the Role

This role sits at the intersection of robotics and data infrastructure at a well-funded, early-stage robotics company. You'll be responsible for building reliable pipelines and storage systems that make large volumes of robot telemetry and sensor data usable for engineering and ML teams. Your work will directly enable faster iteration and safer robotic systems — from raw sensor ingestion all the way through to training-ready datasets and real-time analytics.

You'll join a cross-functional team of robotics engineers, software engineers, and data scientists in a fast-paced, on-site environment in Los Angeles, CA. This is a high-impact, hands-on role with broad scope at a company building at the frontier of physical AI and robotics.

Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build scalable data pipelines to ingest and process robot telemetry and sensor data (camera, LiDAR, IMU, and more).

  • Implement storage solutions and schemas that support analytics, model training, and data replay.

  • Ensure data quality, validation, and lineage across ingestion and transformation stages.

  • Optimize latency and throughput for both real-time and batch processing use cases.

  • Instrument observability, monitoring, and alerting for data flows and infrastructure.

  • Collaborate closely with robotics engineers and data scientists to translate platform needs into production-grade implementations.

  • Productionize ETL/ELT workflows with CI/CD and automated testing.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents affecting data availability or correctness.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building data infrastructure or engineering pipelines specifically for robotics sensor data — this is a dealbreaker requirement.

  • Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining data ingestion, processing, and storage pipelines for sensor data (e.g., camera, LiDAR, IMU).

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, databases, and data pipeline design.

  • Proficiency in Python and/or C++ for building data tooling and pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms and distributed processing tools — e.g., AWS or GCP, Kafka or Pub/Sub, Spark or Flink, Airflow.

  • Experience with containerization and deployment of data pipelines using Docker and Kubernetes, plus basic CI/CD.

  • Experience with time-series databases and telemetry data management in a robotics context.

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset for working across engineering and ML teams.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with ROS / ROS2 robotics middleware.

  • Familiarity with ML workflow tooling such as MLFlow or Kubeflow for end-to-end robotics data pipelines.

  • Experience with robotics simulation tools (e.g., Gazebo) and synthetic data generation.

  • Prior experience in an early-stage or high-growth startup environment.

Location

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Los Angeles, CA. Candidates based in or willing to relocate to the Los Angeles area are strongly preferred. The company also has a presence in New York City, NY and San Francisco, CA.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience, including equity participation appropriate for an early-stage company. Specific details will be shared during the interview process.

raw.description:
About Clarity Pediatrics
Clarity Pediatrics is building a new model for pediatric chronic care — one that brings affordable, science-backed care to the 1 in 3 kids with chronic conditions. We deliver virtual, evidence-based care that’s accessible, collaborative, and designed to support families and providers alike. We’ve started with ADHD and anxiety, and we’re working to expand into other chronic conditions like asthma, allergies, and obesity. Backed by $10M from leading healthcare investors, we’re led by experienced clinicians and healthcare leaders with deep domain expertise and a shared commitment to clinical excellence.

Our Culture

We’re building a team of clinicians who are collaborative, curious, and committed to delivering exceptional care. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Co-founded by a pediatric provider, with exceptional clinical leaders including licensed mental health providers in key roles shaping every major decision

  • Clinical model built to partner closely with referring providers

  • Multidisciplinary collaboration and robust case consultation opportunities

  • A diverse, inclusive, and mission-driven community where your voice matters

  • Access to expert clinical guidance from ADHD and anxiety specialists and researchers

  • Ongoing opportunities for professional growth and training

What We Offer

We’re committed to taking care of the healthcare providers who care for our patients. Our benefits include:

  • Fully remote and flexible schedule

  • Salary $85,000-$110,000/year (full-time)

  • Available bonus opportunities

  • Medical, dental, vision, and ancillary benefits

  • 401(k)

  • Flexible PTO

  • CME/CEU support and reimbursement

  • Remote-friendly work culture

  • A dedicated care coordination team to support with administrative tasks (e.g., cancellations, rescheduling, documentation requests, billing)

  • And more—we’re growing and evolving, so tell us what matters most to you!

About the Role

Clarity Pediatrics is seeking full time, licensed Child and Family Therapists to join our remote, multidisciplinary team. You’ll provide clinical services including ADHD and anxiety assessments and leading parenting groups such as Parent Training in Behavior Management (BPT) and Supportive Parenting for Anxious Childhood Emotion (SPACE).

We’re committed to setting clinicians up for success with peer consultation groups, guidance from ADHD and anxiety experts, and stipends for professional development. You’ll also have the opportunity to shape our care model and improve workflows that support high-quality, sustainable care. We value diverse clinical backgrounds and encourage you to grow your expertise, lead initiatives, and focus on what you do best.

With our full time (40 hr/week) role, enjoy flexible scheduling within our operating hours (weekdays 8 am – 8 pm and Saturdays), in the time zone where you provide care.

What You’ll Own

  • Conduct comprehensive ADHD and anxiety assessments and intake evaluations for new patients and families

  • Provide personalized treatment recommendations, including referrals to community providers when appropriate

  • Lead group therapy sessions for caregivers of children with ADHD, anxiety, and co-occurring conditions such as Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver high-quality, integrated care

  • Opportunities exist to contribute to program development, evaluation, and research initiatives—based on your interests and organizational needs

About You

  • You’re a licensed mental health professional (LPCC, LMFT, or LCSW) with a master’s degree in a relevant field—and you're passionate about providing excellent care to kids and families.

  • You’re currently licensed in California and open to getting licensed in other states (we’ll support you with that!)

  • You have experience working in integrated care settings and enjoy using evidence-based approaches, especially for pediatric ADHD and anxiety.

  • You’re tech-savvy, a quick learner, and excited about shaping the future of behavioral health through innovative, virtual care.

  • You’re energized by collaboration and interested in building better systems—whether through care model design, new tools, or team initiatives.

  • This role is remote, so you’re able to work from a private, secure location with strong internet—and you’re open to working at least 2 hours per week during peak times (M-F 6:00-8pm PT, and/or Saturday 8am-2pm)

  • Spanish proficiency

Nice to Have

  • Licensed in additional states

raw.description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

As Technical Lead, Machine Learning, you own the execution layer of A1’s intelligence. You translate research direction into reliable, scalable, production-grade ML systems.

This role sits at the intersection of research, infrastructure, and product. You are responsible for making models trainable, deployable, observable, and performant under real-world constraints.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end ML system execution: data pipelines, training workflows, evaluation systems, inference architecture, and deployment.

  • Fine-tune and adapt models using state-of-the-art methods such as LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, and distillation.

  • Architect and operate scalable inference systems, balancing latency, cost, and reliability.

  • Design and maintain data systems for high-quality synthetic and real-world training data.

  • Implement evaluation pipelines covering performance, robustness, safety, and bias, in partnership with research leadership.

  • Own production deployment, including GPU optimization, memory efficiency, latency reduction, and scaling policies.

  • Collaborate closely with application engineering to integrate ML systems cleanly into backend, mobile, and desktop products.

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs and ship improvements quickly, learning from real usage.

  • Work under real production constraints: latency, cost, reliability, and safety

Outcomes

  • Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets.

  • ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable.

  • Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact.

  • Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction.

  • Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time.

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • GPU-based training and inference system

Ideal Experience

  • You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos.

  • You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes.

  • You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness.

  • You are self-directed, pragmatic, and take full ownership of outcomes.

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate well in small, high-trust teams.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreImprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

Role Summary

The Risk team at Imprint is responsible for making smarter, faster credit decisions that balance growth with responsible risk management. The team builds the models, policies, and analytical systems that power underwriting, fraud detection, and portfolio optimization across all of Imprint’s credit programs.

As a Data Scientist, Risk, you will own the modeling powering Imprint’s top-of-funnel credit decisioning—from application intake through approval—across every acquisition channel: direct affiliates (Credit Karma, NerdWallet), invitation-to-apply emails, direct mail, paid social, instant prescreens, and on-site applications. Your primary focus will be improving approval rates while maintaining credit quality: building better underwriting models, designing policy experiments, and uncovering segments where we can safely expand access to credit.

This role sits at the intersection of credit and acquisition strategy. You will partner directly with Credit Strategy, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to build targeting models for new channels, evaluate channel-level credit performance, and connect acquisition volume to downstream economics—approval rates, vintage loss forecasts, LTV, CAC, and contribution profit. Increasingly, that means building not just analyses but AI-powered systems that can autonomously monitor approval rate, channel performance, diagnose shifts, and recommend policy adjustments.

The Opportunity

  • Own and improve the full top-of-funnel credit decisioning pipeline: application scoring, policy rules, decline waterfalls, and approval rate optimization across direct affiliates, invitation-to-apply, direct mail, paid social, instant prescreens, and on-site applications

  • Build and iterate on underwriting, targeting, and segmentation models that expand safe approvals and improve channel-level acquisition quality

  • Design and analyze A/B tests and champion/challenger experiments on credit policies, establishing a test-and-learn cadence with structured readouts on both acquisition and credit performance

  • Build channel-level performance models that connect application volume to downstream economics: approval rates, expected losses, LTV, CAC, and contribution profit

  • Design and build agentic workflows and AI-powered monitoring systems that autonomously detect approval rate anomalies, diagnose score drift and population mix changes, and recommend policy adjustments

  • Partner directly with Credit Strategy, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to develop targeting criteria and risk frameworks for new and emerging acquisition channels

  • Build segmentation frameworks to identify underserved populations where credit access can be responsibly expanded

Your Profile

Required

  • 5 to 8+ years of experience in data science, risk analytics, or a related quantitative field, ideally at a high-growth startup or fintech company

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with the ability to build models, transform raw data, and create custom datasets from complex financial data

  • Experience building credit risk or targeting models (scorecards, underwriting models, segmentation) or similar predictive modeling in a regulated environment

  • Deep understanding of statistical inference, experimentation design, and causal analysis, with the ability to disentangle policy impact from population shifts and channel mix changes

  • Comfort with AI tools and AI-native workflows; you actively use tools like Claude, Copilot, or similar to accelerate your work and are excited to build AI-powered analytical systems

  • Full-stack problem-solving orientation: you dive into messy data, trace a decline to its root cause, and question assumptions in pursuit of a better answer

  • Ability to present complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and external partner stakeholders

  • Comfort owning projects end-to-end in a fast-moving startup environment with limited scaffolding, collaborating cross-functionally with Policy, Strategy, Product, and Engineering

Nice to Have

  • Experience with credit card underwriting, lending, or consumer credit products

  • Familiarity with credit bureau data (Vantage, FICO, tradeline attributes) and alternative data sources

  • Experience building or scaling experimentation infrastructure for credit policy testing

  • Exposure to fraud detection, KYC/IDV workflows, or application fraud models

  • Understanding of acquisition channel economics and experience partnering with marketing or credit strategy teams on targeting and LTV modeling

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring strong fundamentals, we encourage you to apply.

Stack

Python and SQL for modeling and analysis. Snowflake for data warehousing. AWS infrastructure. Dashboarding and monitoring tools for production systems.

Learn More

Learn more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog:

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $170K - $200K

About the Role

A small, fast-moving defense tech startup in Austin, TX is hiring a hands-on Senior Robotics Engineer to design the physical control systems powering high-speed interceptor platforms. This is an onsite, mission-critical role sitting at the intersection of control theory, embedded software, and real-world robotics — directly impacting system performance against emerging threats. You'll be a core member of a tight-knit engineering team focused on shipping field-ready capability.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement physical control systems — the "body" — for interceptor platforms.

  • Develop high-bandwidth control loops and advanced control algorithms (e.g., PID, model-predictive, adaptive control) to ensure vehicle stability and precise high-speed maneuvers under dynamic load.

  • Write high-quality, efficient embedded code (primarily Rust, C, or C++) to manage actuators, motor drivers (via CAN bus), and sensors on RTOS.

  • Integrate and fuse camera and IMU data (e.g., EKF/UKF) on embedded platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson for reliable, real-time state estimation.

  • Translate computer-vision tracking output into reliable motor commands that steer the interceptor.

  • Build and maintain Python-based tools for calibration, logging, and CI/CD to support rapid iteration and deployment.

  • Work fully onsite in Austin, TX as a full-time member of a small, senior engineering team.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in robotics, controls, or embedded systems.

  • Strong control theory fundamentals — expertise in PID, model-predictive or adaptive control, and performance tuning for robotics.

  • Proficiency in Rust, C, or C++ for embedded, low-latency hardware interaction.

  • Deep experience with embedded platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson), camera pipelines, IMUs, and sensor fusion techniques (EKF/UKF).

  • Hands-on knowledge of motor drivers, CAN bus, RTOS, and ROS2/DDS or similar middleware.

  • End-to-end autonomy development experience: translating computer vision outputs into reliable motor commands.

  • U.S. citizenship and ability to pass a background check; existing security clearance or ability to obtain one is required.

  • A demonstrated passion for building robots or engineering projects — in or out of work.

Nice to Have

  • PCB design familiarity and EMC awareness; experience with oscilloscopes, logic/CAN analyzers, and basic rework.

  • Prior defense startup or mission-driven product experience.

  • Safety-critical workflow experience.

  • Model-predictive or adaptive control expertise beyond PID.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: $150,000 – $250,000 USD annually, commensurate with experience.

  • Equity participation in an early-stage, high-growth defense tech company.

  • Comprehensive benefits package.

Location

This role is fully onsite in Austin, TX. Remote and hybrid arrangements are not available. Visa sponsorship is not available — U.S. citizenship is required for security clearance eligibility.

As a Customer Experience Specialist at Omnidian, you'll play a pivotal role in managing high-sentiment escalations and ensuring our customers receive a path to total system recovery. In this role, you will be the main point of contact for escalated customer escalations, helping them find a clear path to getting their solar systems back up and running. You will report to the Customer Experience Manager and act as a central hub, coordinating with internal teams to resolve routine friction and keep the planet’s energy assets performing at their best.

  • You seek to understand others point of view
  • You are a team player
