raw.title: Head of Quality Engineering (Remote - Work from Anywhere)
raw.excerpt: Work from anywhere, impact everywhere Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
raw.description:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position

Work from anywhere!

Position overview

We're looking for a Head of Quality Engineering to join our technology function, reporting directly to the CTO. At Xapo, we are building truly cross-functional teams with full ownership of design, architecture, building, testing, delivery, data, and operations, structured as Stream Aligned Teams (SATs), Platform teams and Enabling teams as per Team Topologies.

This role owns the quality framework across the entire technology function, coverage standards, gate criteria, AI-assisted test tooling, SAT enablement, and pre-release veto authority. You give engineering, apps, and web a single accountable owner for what "quality" means and how it is measured.

This is not a traditional QA role. You will not sit in a test team checking other people's code, SAT engineers own quality in their own code (shift-left). You own the system engineers test within: the framework, the tooling, the gates, and the standards.

The role is deliberately tooling-heavy over headcount-heavy. Your budget is for tooling and AI tokens, not for building a QA team beneath you. The agentic QA pipeline is already in active PoC with positive early results; you will own scaling it to production. Your north star: fully automated quality enforcement, where releases are blocked automatically when rigorous checks fail, without needing human intervention. Target: more than 80% of release quality decisions made by automated tooling within 12 months of hire.

This is an opportunity to shape how a regulated crypto bank defines and enforces software quality, at the intersection of engineering excellence, AI-assisted tooling, and a genuinely high-stakes production environment.

Responsibilities

  • Quality framework definition: own coverage standards (unit, service, integration, end-to-end), gate criteria, and the quality contribution to the function-level Definition of Done. Aligned with Head of Engineering on backend and Head of Frontend Engineering on client-side.
  • Coverage baselines: define measurable coverage thresholds per service and per tribe, with trend visibility, and drive adoption across teams.
  • Pre-release veto authority: hold and exercise the authority to block releases when quality gates are not met. Own the automated tooling that makes this veto self-triggering rather than dependent on a single person.
  • AI-assisted test tooling: define and drive the framework for automated test generation, regression coverage, integration test tooling, and the agentic QA pipeline. You are the designer and driver; implementation is a cross-functional effort with Platform, backend, web, and mobile engineers.
  • SAT enablement: produce the training, documentation, tooling, and templates that let Stream Aligned Team engineers do quality work themselves, without a separate QA function.
  • Test environment strategy: partner with Head of Platform Engineering on dedicated QA environments, test data management, and integration test infrastructure.
  • Quality posture reporting: own the metrics like defect escape rate, coverage trends, release veto rate, AI tooling adoption progress, and percentage of releases requiring no manual quality intervention.
  • Security testing integration: partner with Security on SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning as components of the quality gate.

Skills needed

  • 8+ years in software quality engineering, with a clear track record of owning quality frameworks across engineering organisations, not just managing a QA team or running manual test cycles.
  • Hands-on experience building CI/CD quality gates at multiple levels: unit, service, integration, and end-to-end. You know where tests go in a pipeline and how to make them block a release reliably.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted test tooling, LLM-driven test generation, agentic QA pipelines, or equivalent. You don't need to have shipped a production-grade system, but you need a genuine point of view and hands-on exposure.
  • Demonstrated ability to raise quality standards without a reporting hierarchy, you have influenced engineering teams through better tooling, documentation, and frameworks, not through authority over people.
  • Solid understanding of distributed, event-driven microservices architectures and what testing them well requires: contract testing, consumer-driven contracts, integration test data strategies.
  • Experience defining and tracking quality metrics: defect escape rate, coverage baselines, release veto rates. You have turned quality into something measurable.
  • Strong written communication, you can write a coverage standard, gate criteria document, or enablement guide that engineers actually read and use.
  • Experience in regulated fintech, payments, or banking environments, with a strong emphasis on mobile-first product delivery. You have an appreciation for the stakes of a quality failure in a customer-funds context, particularly within the unique constraints and user expectations of a mobile application environment

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with agentic or generative AI test tooling in production or near-production contexts.
  • Familiarity with Team Topologies, how Stream Aligned, Platform, and Enabling teams interact in practice.
  • Security testing experience: SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and how these integrate into a CI/CD quality gate.
  • Background in crypto, Web3, custody, or blockchain-based systems.
  • Open-source contributions or external thought leadership (talks, articles, OSS projects) related to quality engineering or test automation.

While your North Star is absolute automation, you possess a "roll-up-your-sleeves" mentality. You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty, jump into the trenches, and manually test the mobile apps yourself if a critical release or an edge-case roadblock requires it.

Other requirements

  • A dedicated workspace.
  • A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
  • Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

  • Shape the Future
    Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

  • Great work-life balanceBuild amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.

  • Expect ExcellenceCollaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

raw.description:
Position Overview

The Director, Security and Privacy leads HCUS’s enterprise security & privacy programs. This role advises executive leadership on the security posture of the organization, including HCUS products, Cloud Services, HCUS business systems, and customer-facing technologies that process or store PHI.

The Director requires a strong understanding of organizational, product, cloud, and customer security, as well as the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business leaders, regulators, auditors, legal counsel, and customers’ C-suite executives. The Director works closely with HLUS Security and coordinates the activities of groups spanning all HCUS business units, and the Product Security Incident Response Team across HCUS, HLUS, and FTYO.

The Director provides guidance on information on security agreements, customer security requirements, regulatory obligations, and risk-management decisions. This role also plans and coordinates company resources to support compliance with HIPAA, SOC 2, applicable state and federal cybersecurity and privacy laws, and other relevant regulatory and contractual frameworks.

As the official HCUS HIPAA Privacy Officer and HIPAA Security Officer, the Director oversees the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of policies, procedures, safeguards, incident-response processes, and compliance activities designed to protect PHI and other sensitive information.

The role places equal emphasis on executing assigned responsibilities and coordinating with departments across the company, including HLUS and FTYO, to promote a consistent, integrated, risk-based approach to security and privacy. Through cross-functional collaboration, the Director supports the achievement of the organization’s short- and long-term security, privacy, and business objectives.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Duties and responsibilities

Privacy & Security Leadership

  • Serve as the organization’s designated HIPAA Security Officer and HIPAA Privacy Officer.
  • Develop, implement, maintain, and enforce the company’s information security, privacy, and program.
  • Establish and maintain a governance framework that supports compliance with HIPAA, HITECH, SOC 2, applicable state privacy laws, breach-notification requirements, contractual obligations, and other relevant healthcare and security standards.
  • Advise executive leadership on security, privacy, technology, and operational risks.
  • Present meaningful security, privacy, audit, and risk metrics to executive leadership and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain awareness of changes in healthcare privacy, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements, translating those changes into actionable organizational improvements.

Policies, Procedures, and Program Management

  • Own the development, review, approval, implementation, and periodic revision of HCUS security and privacy policies, standards, procedures, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure policies address administrative, physical, and technical safeguards appropriate to HCUS’s systems, workforce, operations, and risk profile.
  • Maintain required HIPAA documentation, including risk analyses, risk management plans, policies, training records, incident documentation, access reviews, vendor assessments, and compliance evidence.
  • Lead periodic program assessments and continuous improvement initiatives to measure and improve security and privacy maturity.

Risk Management and Security Assessments

  • Lead HCUS-wide security and privacy risk assessments, including HIPAA Security Rule risk analysis and periodic reassessments.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track remediation of security, privacy, operational, technical, and third-party risks.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product Management, HLUS Shared IT Services, Legal, and TAC teams to ensure security and privacy are incorporated into system design, software development, deployment, and operational processes.
  • Oversee vulnerability management, penetration testing, security testing, configuration reviews, access control reviews, and remediation tracking.
  • Ensure security controls are proportionate to HCUS’s risk profile and the sensitivity of PHI and other confidential information.

SOC 2, Audit, and Regulatory Readiness

  • Lead the HCUS’s SOC 2 program, including scoping, control design, evidence collection, readiness activities, auditor coordination, remediation management, and annual attestation efforts.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits, customer assessments, security questionnaires, and regulatory inquiries.
  • Maintain audit-ready evidence demonstrating operation of security and privacy controls.
  • Monitor compliance with contractual commitments, Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), customer security requirements, and data protection obligations.
  • Partner with internal teams and external advisors to address audit findings, corrective action plans, and compliance gaps.

Incident Response and Breach Management

  • Continuously develop, maintain, test, and improve the HCUS’s security incident response and breach-response plans.
  • Lead or coordinate response activities for suspected or confirmed security incidents, privacy incidents, and PHI breaches.
  • Ensure incidents are appropriately investigated, documented, contained, remediated, and reviewed.
  • Coordinate with leadership, legal counsel, technical teams, customers, insurers, and other stakeholders as appropriate during significant incidents.
  • Support breach-risk assessment and notification decision-making in accordance with HIPAA, state law, contractual requirements, and company policy.
  • Conduct post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions are assigned, tracked, and completed.

Technical Security Oversight

  • Partner with technical leadership to oversee the security architecture and safeguards protecting cloud environments, applications, endpoints, networks, identities, integrations, and data.
  • Support implementation and operation of controls such as identity and access management, multi-factor authentication, encryption, logging and monitoring, secure configuration management, vulnerability management, backup and recovery, and business continuity capabilities.
  • Promote secure software development lifecycle practices, including security requirements, code review, dependency management, security testing, threat modeling, and release controls.
  • Ensure appropriate protections for medical imaging data, DICOM workflows, integrations, APIs, interoperability platforms, and connected customer environments.

Vendor, Customer, and Third-Party Risk Management

  • Establish and oversee a third-party risk management program for vendors, subcontractors, cloud service providers, and other business partners that may access, process, transmit, or store PHI or other sensitive data.
  • Review security and privacy due diligence materials, including SOC reports, penetration testing summaries, certifications, data protection terms, and business continuity documentation.
  • Ensure appropriate contractual safeguards, including BAAs and security requirements, are in place before third-party access to PHI or sensitive systems is granted.
  • Support customer due diligence requests, security reviews, and discussions with customer information security, privacy, procurement, and compliance teams.

Workforce Education and Culture

  • Develop and administer security and privacy awareness training for all HCUS members.
  • Ensure role-based training is provided to employees and contractors with specialized responsibilities or access to PHI, production systems, or sensitive information.
  • Foster a culture of security, privacy, accountability, and timely incident reporting across HCUS.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, Privacy, Risk Management, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in information security, privacy, compliance, risk management, healthcare technology, or related discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience leading or managing security, privacy, compliance, or governance programs.
  • Demonstrated experience with HIPAA Privacy Rule, HIPAA Security Rule, HITECH Act requirements, and healthcare breach response.
  • Experience leading SOC 2 readiness, audits, control implementation, and evidence management.
  • Experience conducting risk assessments, developing risk treatment plans, and managing remediation activities.
  • Experience developing and maintaining incident response, business continuity, and disaster recovery processes.
  • Strong knowledge of common security frameworks and standards, such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-66, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria.
  • Familiarity with cloud security, SaaS application security, identity and access management, encryption, logging/monitoring, secure software development practices, and vendor risk management.
  • Ability to communicate complex security, privacy, and regulatory concepts effectively to technical teams, customers, executives, and non-technical workforce members.
  • Strong judgment, organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage sensitive and confidential matters.

Preferred requirements

  • Experience in a healthcare SaaS, medical imaging, health IT, clinical informatics, PACS, RIS, DICOM, interoperability, or medical device-adjacent environment
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, HCISPP, CHPC, CHC, CHSP, CIPM, CIPP/US, or equivalent.
  • Experience with HITRUST, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FDA cybersecurity considerations, or state healthcare privacy regulations.
  • Experience managing customer security assessments and enterprise healthcare customer requirements.
  • Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Familiarity with security operations, SIEM/logging platforms, endpoint protection, vulnerability scanning, and cloud security posture management tools.

Physical requirements

The position requires the ability to perform the following physical demands and/or have the listed capabilities:

  • The ability to sit up 75-100% of applicable work
  • The ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to stand, talk, and hear for 75% of applicable work
  • The ability to lift and carry up to ten pounds up to 20% of applicable work
  • Close Vision: The ability to see clearly at twenty inches or less.

Travel

  • Occasional (up to 25%) travel may be required based on business

Salary and Benefits

  • $134,406.00 to $186,696.00
  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Life Insurance
  • 401K
  • Paid Time Off

Applicants to positions where vendor credentialing or other similar requirements exist to enter facilities will be required to comply with the credentialing requirements of the facilities, including complying with vaccine requirements. For all positions, the Company encourages vaccination against COVID-19 and requires that the successful candidate hired be willing to test for the COVID-19 virus periodically and wear a face covering indoors as required, absent being granted an accommodation due to medical or sincerely held religious belief or other legally required exemption.

raw.description:
We are seeking a Lead Data Engineer to support a large-scale healthcare data platform initiative focused on modernizing data ingestion, automation, and semantic layer capabilities within Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role will play a critical part in building scalable, reliable, and business-ready data solutions that enable enterprise analytics and reporting across the organization.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on engineering expertise, deep knowledge of cloud-native data platforms, and experience leading technical implementation efforts in complex enterprise healthcare environments.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines supporting enterprise healthcare analytics and reporting use cases
  • Lead automation efforts across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and operational monitoring workflows
  • Develop and maintain ingestion frameworks for structured and semi-structured healthcare data sources
  • Build and expand semantic data layers within GCP and BigQuery to support consistent, trusted business reporting and analytics consumption
  • Design scalable ELT/ETL workflows leveraging modern cloud-native architecture patterns
  • Partner closely with architects, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into scalable technical solutions
  • Optimize BigQuery performance, partitioning, and cost management strategies
  • Implement engineering best practices for testing, observability, reliability, and deployment automation
  • Support data governance, data quality, and metadata management initiatives across the platform
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across delivery teams

Required Skills

  • Strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly:
    • BigQuery
    • Cloud Storage
    • Cloud Composer / orchestration tooling
    • Dataflow or modern ingestion frameworks
  • Experience designing and building scalable data ingestion and pipeline automation frameworks
  • Strong understanding of semantic layer development and dimensional modeling concepts
  • Advanced SQL and Python development skills
  • Experience with ETL/ELT pipeline design and orchestration
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and cloud engineering best practices
  • Strong understanding of data quality, observability, and operational reliability principles
  • Experieng with AI driven workflows, and orchestration design patterns.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with healthcare data ecosystems and regulated enterprise environments
  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards or payer/provider analytics platforms
  • Experience supporting enterprise BI and analytics initiatives
  • Exposure to dbt, Looker, or semantic modeling frameworks is a plus

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in data engineering or cloud data platform development
  • Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale cloud data solutions in GCP environments
  • Experience leading technical workstreams or mentoring engineering teams
  • Consulting or client-facing experience strongly preferred

What Makes You Successful

  • You are passionate about building scalable and maintainable cloud-native data solutions
  • You balance hands-on engineering execution with technical leadership and collaboration
  • You communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
  • You thrive in fast-paced, delivery-focused environments
  • You bring strong ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement mindset to your work

The starting pay range for this role is $125,000 - $160,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 also offers a competitive benefits program to meet the health and financial well-being of our team and their families. You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, paid holidays, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs.

BLEND360 is an acclaimed, forward-thinking Data, Digital Marketing, & AI Solutions Company, dedicated to fueling remarkable outcomes for our Fortune 500 clients. Our trajectory is one of continuous expansion, emerging at the crossroads of cutting-edge analytics, data proficiency, technology, and digital marketing excellence.

raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.


The Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter (Global) to drive hiring across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Infrastructure, and other technical functions globally.

This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will be responsible for attracting top technical talent, partnering with senior stakeholders on hiring strategy, and helping build a high-performing Talent Acquisition function as the company continues to scale globally.

You will play a critical role in shaping BJAK’s technical workforce while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing best-in-class recruiting practices across the organization.


What You’ll Do

Technical Recruitment Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end recruitment process for technical positions across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Machine Learning, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, QA, and related functions.

  • Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring requirements, interview strategies, talent profiles, and workforce planning priorities.

  • Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, talent mapping, compensation insights, and hiring recommendations.

  • Drive recruitment outcomes for complex, senior, niche, and business-critical technical positions globally.

  • Develop and execute innovative sourcing strategies to identify and engage top passive talent across competitive international markets.

Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence

  • Build and maintain strong technical talent pipelines to support both immediate and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets.

  • Stay current on technical hiring trends, market conditions, compensation benchmarks, and talent availability across key regions.

Team Development & Process Excellence

  • Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing capability, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management effectiveness.

  • Establish and continuously improve recruitment processes, sourcing methodologies, interview calibration standards, and hiring best practices.

  • Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Contribute to the growth and development of the global Talent Acquisition team as the organization scales.

Recruitment Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.

  • Track key recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and hiring quality.

  • Ensure a positive, professional, and consistent candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

  • Support compliance with local hiring regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.


The Right Fit Has

  • 5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, with significant exposure to technical hiring.

  • Proven track record recruiting for Software Engineering, Product Management, Data Science, AI/ML, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, or related technical functions.

  • Demonstrated success hiring senior and difficult-to-fill technical positions in competitive talent markets.

  • Strong sourcing expertise using LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, networking, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques.

  • Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.

  • Strong understanding of technical talent markets, technical role requirements, and engineering organizational structures.

  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing hiring decisions through data, insights, and market expertise.

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries.

  • Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills.

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently delivers high-quality technical hires across multiple functions and regions.

  • Builds strong, sustainable talent pipelines for critical technical roles.

  • Serves as a trusted hiring partner to technical leaders and executives.

  • Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience.

  • Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth.

  • Opportunity to build world-class technical teams globally.

  • Exposure to complex international hiring across multiple markets.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

  • Meaningful work that directly contributes to the future of technology and AI-enabled products.

Quer fazer parte de um time que cria oportunidades e potencializa a evolução?

Como alcançamos tudo isso?

Através de um ecossistema de mais de 12 mil pessoas inconformadas que, juntas, oferecem soluções, produtos e educam o mercado. Atuamos como uma Única TOTVS, integrando diferentes soluções e expertises para educar o mercado e simplificar o mundo dos negócios. Para nós, a evolução é constante e acontece de gente para gente: usamos nossa inquietude para antecipar tendências e transformar o crescimento real da tecnologia.


Nosso jeito de ser:

🤖IH + IA (Inteligência Humana + Inteligência Artificial): Acreditamos que a tecnologia potencializa, mas as pessoas direcionam. Aqui, a IA nos dá escala e eficiência, enquanto a nossa Inteligência Humana traz a estratégia, o contexto e o cuidado. É essa combinação que nos permite criar soluções inovadoras com um propósito real.

🚀Protagonismo e Evolução: Somos movidos pelo aprendizado contínuo e pela coragem de assumir o comando da própria carreira. Aqui, incentivamos a inquietude e oferecemos o ambiente fértil para quem quer crescer, criar e se transformar.

Resultado Responsável: Valorizamos a liberdade para agir e a responsabilidade com o todo. Aqui, você tem voz para desafiar o status quo e autonomia para buscar resultados que gerem valor real para nossos clientes e para a sociedade.

🧘🏼‍♀️Bem-Estar Integral: Cuidamos de quem faz a evolução acontecer. Buscamos o bem-estar integral de cada pessoa colaboradora, por meio de ações e benefícios que viabilizam recursos de autocuidado através de 5 pilares: Emocional, Financeiro, Físico, Ocupacional e Social.

🫂Pluralidade e Pertencimento: A diversidade é o que nos torna potentes. Promovemos a inclusão e o pertencimento de forma ativa, garantindo que a TOTVS seja um lugar onde você pode ser quem você é. Nossa expertise é humana e viva: acolhemos as diferenças para empoderar negócios dentro e fora da empresa.

Seu desafio no time:

Você fará parte do time de Addon WhatsApp, focado na evolução e adoção do nosso produto de mensageria. Nossa missão é melhorar resultados e otimizar as jornadas de comunicação, percepção de valor e engajamento dos usuários. Seu desafio será conduzir a resolução de desafios técnicos de frontend, entregando interfaces conversacionais, componentes e experiências de usuário confiáveis, performáticas e escaláveis.

Suas principais entregas:

  • Desenvolver, testar e fazer o deploy de novas funcionalidades e melhorias nas funcionalidades existentes, garantindo um codebase saudável, com poucos débitos técnicos e bugs.
  • Realizar code reviews em pull requests de outras pessoas desenvolvedoras, dando feedback e contribuindo para a qualidade técnica do time.
  • Atuar na operação do produto utilizando processos e ferramentas para garantir a
    experiência do cliente.
  • Prestar suporte a clientes internos e externos (tickets e dúvidas), com postura customer-first e foco na solução definitiva dos problemas.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento com colegas, com a empresa e com o mercado.
  • Desenvolver soluções considerando aspectos como custos, impacto e otimização de recursos.
  • Colaborar em discussões técnicas e planejamento de produto.
  • Desenvolver e manter componentes e funcionalidades em React, garantindo a qualidade e eficiência do código.
  • Colaborar com o time para implementar melhorias contínuas no produto, focando na experiência do usuário.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias do Scrum, contribuindo para o planejamento e execução das sprints.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com áreas de negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas.
  • Propor e implementar soluções inovadoras que melhorem o fluxo de vendas e a experiência do cliente.

Perfil que buscamos:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento frontend, principalmente em React
  • Experiência com Git e boas práticas de controle de versão.
  • Domínio em ferramentas de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, etc.).
  • Autonomia para conduzir tarefas de desenvolvimento de ponta a ponta.
  • Conhecimento de module bundlers (Webpack, Rollup, Parcel).
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (unitários e integração).

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com micro front-ends.
  • Experiência com navegação SPA (single page applications).
  • Ter atuado em produtos de conversas.
  • Interesse ou experiência com produtos que envolvam vendas ou integração com plataformas de conversa, chatbot e IA.
  • Interesse em compartilhar conhecimento por meio de mentorias, comunidades, artigos, palestras, projetos open source ou outras iniciativas de colaboração.

Etapas do processo seletivo:

  • Aplicação - Envio da inscrição;
  • Mindsight – Teste de estilo de trabalho;
  • Talent Acquisition - Entrevista por competência com o time de recrutamento;
  • Entrevista Técnica - Entrevista técnica para discussão de requisitos da vaga;
  • Entrevista Final - Conversa final com a gerência para alinhamento;
  • Offer - Fase de conclusão do processo seletivo, com a apresentação da proposta de trabalho.

Obs: Podem ter etapas complementares e/ou alterações, de acordo com a necessidade do processo.

🔒 Nos comprometemos com a segurança dos seus dados! Em nosso Aviso de Privacidade, descrevemos quais dados coletamos, como são consumidos e armazenados, em conformidade com a LGPD.

Se você é uma pessoa movida por desafios, criatividade e impacto genuíno, avance conosco nessa jornada de evolução!

Faça parte do nosso time!

raw.description:
About the Role

Our client is a specialist UK-based business operating within the asset finance sector. They are looking for a highly articulate and commercially aware LinkedIn Appointment Setter / Cold Messaging Specialist to support their business development activity.

This is not a high-volume, copy-and-paste outreach position.

The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting carefully researched LinkedIn outreach, building relationships with senior professionals within the finance sector, generating strong response rates, and ultimately booking qualified meetings for the company’s directors.

The business operates in a highly relationship-driven and reputation-sensitive market. For that reason, outreach needs to feel personalised, credible and consultative rather than aggressive or sales-led.

The role would suit someone who genuinely understands how to use LinkedIn as a relationship-building and appointment-setting platform and can explain not only what they are doing, but why a particular outreach strategy is likely to work.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct approximately 50 high-quality, personalised LinkedIn outreach messages per day.
  • Research prospects before making contact and tailor messaging accordingly.
  • Build rapport with senior professionals across the asset finance and broader financial services sectors.
  • Re-engage prospects who may already have an existing relationship or previous conversation with the directors.
  • Generate strong response rates from LinkedIn outreach.
  • Convert conversations into qualified appointments for the company’s directors.
  • Manage LinkedIn connection requests strategically and consistently.
  • Develop appropriate messaging sequences for different prospect types.
  • Follow up with prospects in a professional and natural manner.
  • Engage with relevant prospects' LinkedIn content where appropriate to increase familiarity and strengthen relationships.
  • Maintain accurate records of outreach activity, responses and appointments.
  • Review outreach performance and adapt messaging based on results.
  • Communicate the strategy behind different approaches and demonstrate commercial reasoning.
  • Initially submit messaging and outreach strategies for approval while learning the company’s tone of voice.
  • Gradually take greater ownership of conversations once trust and consistency have been established.
  • Learn how the directors communicate and ensure messages sound authentic and aligned with the company.
  • Potentially manage outreach through a director's LinkedIn account once sufficient trust has been established.

What the Client Is Looking For

The client is looking for someone considerably stronger than a basic administrator or junior appointment setter.

They want someone who understands that successful LinkedIn outreach is about credibility, research, positioning and communication, rather than simply sending large numbers of messages.

Finance Sector Experience

Previous experience working within financial services, finance recruitment, banking, asset finance or another finance-related environment is highly desirable and considered important for this role.

Candidates do not necessarily need direct asset finance experience, but they should be comfortable communicating with professionals working in a sophisticated financial environment.

Strong LinkedIn Knowledge

LinkedIn will be the primary platform used in the role.

The ideal candidate will already have:

  • A professional and credible LinkedIn profile.
  • A good understanding of LinkedIn networking.
  • Experience conducting direct outreach.
  • Knowledge of connection-building strategies.
  • An understanding of how profile credibility influences response rates.
  • Experience generating conversations and meetings through LinkedIn.

A strong existing LinkedIn presence would be particularly advantageous.

Strategic Thinking

The client does not simply want someone who follows instructions.

They want someone capable of looking at a prospect and deciding:

  • Why should we approach this person?
  • What will make them respond?
  • What angle should we use?
  • What previous relationship or information can we reference?
  • Should we message them immediately or build familiarity first?
  • How should we follow up?
  • Why is this approach likely to work?

Candidates must therefore be able to demonstrate strategic thinking alongside execution.

Excellent Written Communication

The company's market is highly relationship-driven.

Messages must therefore be:

  • Professional.
  • Natural.
  • Concise.
  • Articulate.
  • Personalised.
  • Commercially intelligent.
  • Appropriate for senior finance professionals.

The client wants outreach that feels like the continuation of a genuine business conversation rather than traditional cold prospecting.

Results Focus

Performance will primarily be assessed on:

  • LinkedIn response rates.
  • Quality of conversations generated.
  • Number of qualified appointments booked.
  • Overall effectiveness of outreach strategies.

The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working towards clear measurable outcomes.

Attention to Detail

This is a quality-over-quantity role.

Rather than sending thousands of automated messages, the expectation is approximately 50 well-considered messages each day.

Candidates need to be thorough, organised and capable of researching prospects before contacting them.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The strongest candidate is likely to have:

  • Previous LinkedIn outreach or appointment-setting experience.
  • Exposure to financial services or another professional services environment.
  • Excellent written English.
  • Strong commercial awareness.
  • Confidence communicating with senior professionals.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong research skills.
  • Experience generating appointments through written outreach.
  • A credible and professional LinkedIn presence.
  • An analytical mindset and interest in improving response rates.
  • The ability to understand and reproduce another person's communication style.
  • The confidence to recommend different outreach approaches rather than simply waiting for instructions.
  • A trustworthy and dependable working style.

Benefits

raw.title: Senior Manager, Airworthiness and Certification
raw.excerpt: About Merlin: Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN) is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non-human pilot to deliver full-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown.
raw.description:
About Merlin:

Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN) is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non-human pilot to deliver full-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown. The Merlin Pilot autonomy system powers a growing range of aircraft and mission profiles and has been proven through hundreds of autonomous flights from Merlin's global flight test facilities, including Kerikeri, New Zealand; Quonset Point, Rhode Island; and soon, Bedford, Massachusetts. Headquartered in Boston, Merlin is expanding its organization to accelerate the development and deployment of its autonomy platform, helping customers solve some of aviation's most pressing challenges, from pilot shortages to improving flight safety. Backed by some of the world's leading investors prior to its public listing, Merlin continues to advance the certification and commercialization of autonomous flight across commercial and defense aviation.

About You:

This role pairs deep, personal expertise in civil certification with the people leadership needed to manage two additional, interdependent certification disciplines: military airworthiness and cyber security certification. You are a proven certification leader with extensive, hands-on experience managing complex civil certification programs through FAA Part 23 and Part 25, EASA CS-23 and CS-25, and foreign validations. You also bring working experience in military airworthiness through MIL-HDBK-516C and MIL-STD-882E compliance. You understand the process rigor and collaborative relationships required to achieve airworthiness approvals across civil and military domains, and how airborne cyber security assurance requirements must be part of the initial design concepts on every new program. You lead by building relationships within the organization and externally with regulators, sponsoring offices, and your own team of certification leads, and you know how to translate emerging and often ambiguous guidance into a defensible, schedule-compatible certification strategy.
Merlin Labs builds autonomous aviation systems for civil and defense customers, and the engineering organization behind that work needs a leader who is personally expert in civil certification and who can manage the work of the military airworthiness lead and Cyber Certification Lead. You will own civil certification (FAA Part 23 and Part 25) directly, while leading the military airworthiness lead and cyber certification lead and their teams, reporting to the VP of Airworthiness & certification. If you want to grow and lead the certification and airworthiness teams that enable Merlin to field robust, certifiable autonomous systems to civil and defense customers on a demanding schedule, this is the role for you.

Responsibilities:

  • Support current New Zealand CAANZ certification activities for the U.S. based aspects and lead Merlin's civil certification strategy with the FAA and other foreign authorities, serving as primary technical authority and primary liaison with regulatory authorities for U.S. certifications.
  • Manage all aspects of new civil certification projects: Core process standardization, A&C initial assessments, compliance strategies and A & C plans, issue papers and risk assessments, and guide the Merlin team to final compliance.
  • Lead and grow the Military Airworthiness and Cyber Certification teams, setting priorities, establishing and standardizing core processes, mentoring, and reviewing technical work while the team executes day-to-day military airworthiness and cyber certification activities.
  • Oversee the military airworthiness certification strategy for Merlin's defense programs through the Military Airworthiness Lead, serving as an escalation point to mitigate technical, resource, and capability risks.
  • Oversee closure of Military Certification Review Items (MCRIs), Issue Papers, and related airworthiness documentation through the Military Airworthiness Lead, ensuring compliance with MIL-HDBK-516C, MIL-STD-882E, applicable DEF STANs, and JSSG guidance.
  • Oversee the cyber security certification strategy across civil and military programs through the Cyber Certification Lead, driving integration of airborne cyber security assurance activities with existing safety and development assurance processes and serve as an escalation point to mitigate technical, resource, capability risks.
  • Partner with the process assurance manager and engineering discipline leads to integrate civil certification, military airworthiness, and cyber security certification processes with Merlin's broader process assurance and configuration management framework.
  • Drive continuous improvement of civil certification, military airworthiness, and cyber security certification processes based on audit findings, program lessons learned, and evolving regulatory and DoD guidance.
  • Report to the VP of Airworthiness & certification on program health for civil certification and military airworthiness projects as well as the process improvement roadmap across all three disciplines.
  • Build scalable, repeatable civil certification, military airworthiness, and cyber security frameworks to ensure the success of all three functions as Merlin adds civil and defense programs to their portfolio.

Qualifications:

  • Direct, hands-on experience achieving FAA Part 23 and/or Part 25 type certificates, amendments, or Supplemental Type Certificates, including EASA CS-23/CS-25 or other foreign validation experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in aerospace engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; master’s degree in a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 12+ years of aerospace certification experience, including significant exposure to FAA and foreign certification processes and 5+ years of experience leading or managing a team of engineers, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management across technical disciplines.
  • Proven ability to lead certification efforts for complex new or novel aircraft technologies: interfacing directly with regulatory authorities and managing certification projects from establishment of certification basis, resolution of issue papers and risk assessments, through certification closure or airworthiness approval.
  • Strong leadership and project management capabilities in cross-functional environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce high-quality certification documentation.
  • Experience with designee appointment and management processes and Organization Designation Authorization (ODA) management.
  • Strong working knowledge of 14 CFR Part 21, 23, 25, and 183.
  • Familiarity in 14 CFR Part 43 and 145 procedures and Part 91 and 135 operations.
  • Working knowledge of:
  • Systems engineering principles — requirements decomposition, V&V planning, and configuration management.
  • Software and hardware assurance standards (DO-178C, DO-254, MIL-STD-882).
  • Safety assessment methodologies: FHA, FMEA/FMECA, FTA, common cause analysis.
  • Airworthiness standards relevant to military platforms — MIL-SPECs, MIL-STDs, JSSG-2001, and MIL-HDBK-516.
  • DoD cybersecurity and information assurance frameworks (e.g., RMF, NIST SP 800-53, CMMC) as they apply to airborne systems and Controlled Unclassified Information on defense programs.
  • Airborne cyber security assurance standards (DO-326A/ED-202A, DO-356A/ED-203A) and how cyber security risk assessments integrate with ARP4754A/ARP4761A safety processes
  • Emerging aerospace technologies such as UAVs or advanced air mobility.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with ASTM F3230 and F3061 consensus standards, or other Part 23 / consensus-based certification bases relevant to small and autonomous aircraft.
  • Background in autonomous or unmanned aviation systems (UAS/UAV).
  • Prior experience in military operational environments.
  • Familiarity with machine learning-based software assurance and its intersection with cyber security certification.
  • Experience building or scaling certification functions in a growing company.
  • Experience in AI applications used in standardization of processes, procedures and requirements.
Merlin Labs offers an innovative, entrepreneurial, and team-focused startup environment. We also offer a top-notch benefits package (health, dental, life, unlimited vacation, and 401k with match) and work/life integration. Being part of the Merlin team allows you to become part of a small team that supports professional development while working together to achieve our mission.
Merlin Labs is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service or obligation or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All job offers are contingent upon the candidate passing background and reference checks.
At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or consider candidates who require visa transfers. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.
If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to:

About Chainlink
Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at .

About The Role

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will play a crucial role in driving the adoption of Chainlink products across the capital markets industry as we continue to expand our presence there.

You will work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to evangelise Chainlink technology across the finance industry and work directly with technical teams at major institutions to gather requirements, scope projects and deliver innovative solutions that address the complex needs of their stakeholders. You will also work directly with internal teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering and Legal and make a significant contribution to the ongoing development of the Chainlink capital markets product strategy.

Your Impact

  • Drive the successful adoption of Chainlink products in the capital markets industry by establishing strong relationships with key stakeholders, including major financial institutions, and providing technical expertise and guidance throughout the sales and implementation process

  • Lead and actively participate in gathering requirements, scoping projects, and designing innovative solutions that leverage Chainlink products to address specific use cases and challenges within the capital markets industry

  • Contribute significantly to the development of the Chainlink capital markets product strategy by providing valuable insights, market feedback, and technical expertise, thereby influencing the direction and roadmap of the product suite

  • Collaborate closely with internal technical teams, including developers and engineers, to provide feedback and guidance on product enhancements, bug fixes, and new feature development, ensuring that the capital markets requirements are effectively addressed

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the capital markets industry, including market trends, challenges, and emerging technologies, to effectively position and promote Chainlink products

Requirements

  • Technical pre/postsales technology experience, working with major institutions within capital markets or payment

  • Experience with, and strong knowledge of blockchain technology and associated areas (e.g. DeFi, tokenisation / digital assets, digital identity, etc.)

  • Hands-on experience with middleware, integration architecture patterns, web services technologies, and APIs

  • Experience building and delivering Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and responding to functional and technical elements of proposals independently,

  • Respond independently and effectively to RFIs, RFPs, and Due Diligence Questionnaires (DDQs) — covering functional, technical, security, and compliance dimensions

  • Build and deliver bespoke Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and prototype integrations that demonstrate viability within the customer's existing technology stack

  • Contribute to and maintain a library of reference architectures, solution accelerators, and technical decision guides for use across the solutions team

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience in any of the following: Solidity, Golang, Rust, JS, Java, Python, C/C++

  • Experience in networking protocols, private IP environments, cloud infrastructure, and the implementation of SSL/TLS security measures

  • Knowledge of capital markets concepts, financial instruments and trading processes, including Corporate actions, PMS, OMS, Exchanges, FMIs, Clearing houses, etc.

  • Experience with permissioned blockchain and public blockchains with familiarity with decentralised oracle design, data feed mechanisms, proof-of-reserve systems, or cross-chain messaging protocols

  • Prior involvement in Digital Assets design, tokenised collateral programs, or digital securities issuance platforms at a regulated financial institution or central bank

  • Experience as a technical author — published white papers, reference architectures, or standards contributions in blockchain, fintech, or capital markets

  • Certifications in AWS / Azure / GCP (Solutions Architect level or above), TOGAF, etc.

All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST).

We carefully review all applications and aim to provide a response to every candidate within two weeks after the job posting closes. The closing date is listed on the job advert, so we encourage you to take the time to thoughtfully prepare your application. We want to fully consider your experience and skills, and you will hear from us regarding the status of your application shortly after the closing date.

Chainlink Labs is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, or ordinances. About the role:

We are looking for a CX Operations Consultant to join our community — someone passionate about transforming business processes into intelligent, automated solutions and applying AI in real operational environments.

Sounds exciting? There’s more to come 💛

What you will do:

  • Evaluate clients' existing customer support platforms (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, etc.) and assess the maturity of their automation and AI feature usage;
  • Develop AI readiness assessments and roadmaps that outline current-state gaps, target-state vision, and a phased implementation plan;

  • Analyze support workflows, ticket categories, volume patterns, and escalation paths to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and high-impact automation opportunities;
  • Stay current on emerging AI technologies, vendor capabilities, and best practices in customer support automation to advise clients on innovation opportunities.

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • Fluency in English;
  • 1+ year of professional experience in designing AI-driven customer support automation and workflow optimization strategies;
  • Strong understanding of customer support operations (ticketing workflows, SLAs, KPIs like CSAT, FCR, AHT);
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, and Intercom, including their automation and AI features;
  • Solid knowledge of AI applications in customer support (chatbots, NLP, auto-triage, agent assist tools);
  • Strong analytical skills to identify automation opportunities and inefficiencies;
  • Experience designing scalable workflows and automation strategies.

Will be an advantage:

  • Basic technical understanding of integrations, APIs, and support system architecture;
  • Experience running structured discovery/audit sessions to analyze support workflows, ticket categories, and volumes;
  • Understanding of how to assess and prioritize initiatives based on ROI and business impact;
  • Experience translating findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Opportunity to cooperate fully remotely;
  • Inclusive international environment;
  • Compensation in USD;
  • Rewards for referring friends;
  • Balance between project workload and personal time, but also – internal health policy;

The Investigator Grants Associate II position is designed to be a key member of the project team while providing grant administration processing and financial support to the Project Team and Finance Teams of Precision’s clients. The position requires the candidate to be detail oriented, meticulous, with advanced organizational skills with the ability to handle large volumes of confidential financial information in a fast-paced environment.

Essential Functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Serve as a financial member of the Project Team with the goal to contribute towards timely, efficient, and accurate preparation and tracking of site payments
  • Review the financial section of the Clinical Trial Agreement (CTA) to prepare the tracking workbook for site payments on a project-by-project and site-by-site basis
  • Responsible for maintaining the advance balance tracking on a project-by-project basis to ensure that sufficient prepaid funds are on-hand to make site payments
  • Work with the respective Project Directors and Project Managers to provide guidance on how to populate the site payment workbook to ensure visits eligible for payment are tracked and processed

  • Prepare the site payment package for the Project Director/Project Manager review and approval
  • Communicate approved payments based upon the terms and conditions of the CTA within the Finance Department and this step will facilitate entry into the financial systems and payment processing
  • Preparation of Aggregate Spend (Sunshine Act) Medicare/Medicaid (MMSE) reporting as applicable
  • Preparation of site payment reconciliations
  • Maintenance of the investigator grant dedicated mailbox
  • Coach and Mentor teammates on Investigator Grants Team
  • Ad hoc financial tasks and duties as assigned by the Senior Manager, Global Investigator Grants
  • Provides support to the Project Team by managing the Investigator Grants pass through budget.
  • Ability to collect data pertaining to patient activity at each site in the workbook use this data to:
    • Create accurate client accrual
    • Pay sites based on Fully Executed Clinical Trial Agreement
    • Project costs to monitor overall budget health
    • Ability to communicate with sites and clients via email to resolve inquiries.
    • Exhibits self-motivation, is detail-oriented and able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment
    • Ability to deliver on commitments, an understanding of the service culture and positive interactions with customers and teammates

Minimum Required:

  • 4-year degree or local country equivalent

  • Prior Accounts Payable experience in global payments

  • Strong analytical skills
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Ability to drive and meet critical deadlines
  • Analyze, reconcile, and communicate financial results with all levels of project team, both internal and at the investigative sites
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Extremely detail oriented and process driven

Preferred:

  • Investigator Payment Specialist, Senior background
  • Exposure to investigator contracts and budgets

Skills:

  • Solid working knowledge and understanding and ability to use MS Office Suite products
  • Intermediate to Advance Excel skills
  • Proactive communication style
  • Ability to work independently, as a team player

Competencies:

  • Demonstrates a working knowledge of excel for the purpose of tracker maintenance
  • Resolves payment related issues and prioritizes workload to meet deadlines with little support from management
  • Exhibits high self-motivation and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment.
  • Motivates other members of the project team to meet financial timelines and project goals.

  • Demonstrates an acceptable degree of professionalism, as evidenced by punctuality, ability to deliver on commitments, and positive interactions with customers and teammates, including good interpersonal skills

raw.excerpt: ABOUT NEW ENERGY NEXUSNew Energy Nexus (NEX) is an international NGO that supports climate solutions and builds a more equitable clean energy economy.
raw.description:
ABOUT NEW ENERGY NEXUS

New Energy Nexus (NEX) is an international NGO that supports climate solutions and builds a more equitable clean energy economy. Our laser focus is on clean energy entrepreneurs: providing them with funds, accelerators, and networks to thrive. They are our main audience and our agent of change.

We started in California in 2004 and now operate across China, India, Southeast Asia, East and West Africa, and Australia. We have leveraged US$5.4 billion in investment and supported more than 11,000 entrepreneurs.

ABOUT THE ROLE & OPPORTUNITY

The Director of Development Strategy & Operations will lead the internal engine behind New Energy Nexus' global fundraising and business development efforts. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, this role sits at the center of NEX's development team — turning what our development and partnerships staff and country teams learn on the ground with funders into a coherent, prioritized fundraising strategy, and making sure the team is coordinated, resourced, and focused on the highest-value opportunities.

This is not primarily a donor-facing relationship management role. It is a strategy, team leadership, and fundraising operations role for someone who understands the business and fund development cycle deeply enough to translate frontline intelligence — what funders are signaling, what's landing and what isn't, where proposals are stalling, which markets and programs are attracting interest — into clear direction for where the team should spend its time.

The Director will lead and develop NEX's global platform-level development team, ensuring that individual team members' skills and expertise are deployed effectively against organizational priorities, while bringing together the knowledge and fundraising capabilities of country leaders, chapter teams, and program leads. The ideal candidate has the analytical rigor and systems mindset of a strong operations leader, paired with real fluency in philanthropic and development finance fundraising, so they can be a credible internal leader and partner to a globally distributed team of fundraisers, country directors, and program leads.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Fundraising Strategy & Intelligence (50%)

  • Help develop a living, prioritized development strategy based on proposal outcomes, funder conversations, and market signals gleaned from team conversations and learnings from fundraisers, country directors, and program leads
  • Identify where NEX should be focusing time and effort across programs and geographies, based on funder appetite, pipeline strength, and organizational priorities.
  • Maintain a clear view of the funding pipeline across the network — by funder, program, chapter, and stage — and flag risks, gaps, or unrestricted-vs-restricted balance issues early.
  • Translate strategy into concrete guidance: which opportunities to prioritize, which proposals need repositioning, where the team is over- or under-invested.
  • Serve as a thought partner to the CEO and program leads on funding strategy, drawing on patterns across markets rather than any single relationship.

Team Coordination & Enablement (35%)

  • Lead and develop the global platform-level development team including recruiting, hiring, onboarding, coaching, and managing performance, and ensure team members' skills are effectively leveraged against NEX's development priorities.
  • Translate the development strategy into a clear rolling work plan for the team, aligning ownership, resources, and timelines.
  • Build strong collaboration across the global development function, bringing together the expertise and fundraising capabilities of platform-level staff, country leaders, fundraisers, and program leads to maximize collective impact.
  • Run the operating rhythm of the fundraising team: pipeline reviews, proposal coordination across programs/chapters/finance/communications, and prioritization check-ins.
  • Coordinate multi-country and multi-program proposals, including combining country and program inputs into a cohesive narrative and budget that aligns with broader NEX operational and growth priorities.
  • Build and own a central library of fundraising collateral - pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, program summaries, impact data - so materials for funder meetings and conference talks can be assembled quickly rather than built from scratch each time.
  • Draft and maintain core funder and conference decks, adapting a standard set of modular slides/content to each audience so our fundraisers can focus their time on external relationship-building and speaking rather than deck production.
  • Partner with the Chief Communications Officer to keep collateral aligned with current messaging, program updates, and brand standards.
  • Provide country leads and fundraisers with the tools, templates, frameworks, and support to raise funds effectively and report consistently.
  • Build feedback loops so that what is learned through funder and country-level engagement consistently makes its way back into strategy, priorities, and team planning.

Systems, Data & Reporting (15%)

  • Accountable for the fundraising CRM and pipeline-tracking systems, ensuring data quality, consistent use across chapters, and useful reporting.
  • Produce regular and ad hoc reporting and dashboards for NEX leadership on pipeline health, funder trends, and progress against platform fundraising goals.
  • Standardize proposal, reporting, and stewardship templates and processes across the global platform-level team.
  • Track outcomes against the fundraising strategy and refine it as new data comes in.
  • Ensure fundraising protocols and internal as well as external reporting are completed on time and to consistent quality standards

SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 6–12 MONTHS

Success in this role will mean building a more coordinated, strategic, and effective global development function. By the end of the first 6–12 months, the Director will have:

  • Established clear visibility into NEX's global fundraising pipeline, priorities, risks, and opportunities, with leadership able to make decisions based on reliable, current information.
  • Built a strong operating rhythm across the global platform-level development team, with clear ownership, effective collaboration, and team members' skills deployed against the highest-priority fundraising opportunities.
  • Improved coordination across platform, country, and program teams so that high-value proposals are prioritized appropriately, developed collaboratively, and submitted on time and at a consistently high quality.
  • Established consistent CRM and pipeline management practices across the development function, with data being used to inform strategy, prioritization, and reporting.
  • Created a well-organized, accessible library of standardized fundraising collateral and tools that enables fundraisers and country teams to move more quickly and consistently.
  • Established effective feedback loops between funder and country-level intelligence, fundraising performance, and the organization's overall development strategy.

Requirements

Professional Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in fundraising, development operations, or a closely related strategy/operations function (e.g., sales operations, revenue operations, or enablement), with at least 5 years touching nonprofit or philanthropic fundraising directly.
  • Demonstrated experience turning frontline or field-level input into strategy and prioritization.
  • Experience managing or closely coordinating a distributed team, including non-direct-report relationships (e.g., chapter or country-based staff).
  • Strong track record with CRM/pipeline systems and translating data into decisions, not just dashboards.
  • Familiarity with the climate, clean energy, or entrepreneurship support landscape is a strong plus.

Personal Attributes

  • Structured, analytical thinker who is comfortable synthesizing messy, qualitative field input into clear recommendations.
  • High level of adaptability in an environment with evolving team structures and workflows, with a genuine comfort operating in ambiguity - this means being a self-starter and embodying a growth mindset.
  • High emotional intelligence — able to lead and support a development team well, build trust with country leads across diverse cultural contexts, and approach unfamiliar markets and norms with genuine curiosity and cultural sensitivity.
  • Exceptional written communication skills — able to distill complex, multi-market fundraising intelligence into concise strategy and proposals.
  • Strong project management skills; able to run a coordination function across concurrent proposals, deadlines, and stakeholders.
  • Comfortable being an internal partner and "connective tissue" role rather than the primary external face of fundraising.
  • Ability to work with a global team across time zones, with periodic travel for internal team meetings and relevant conferences/convenings.
  • Proficiency in database/CRM management, Google Workspace, and Slack.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Foundational knowledge of global clean energy and climate change solutions and ecosystems and willingness to engage in in-depth self-learning on any gaps.
  • Experience building or adding structure to a development operations function from an earlier, more informal stage.
  • Due to the global nature of the organization and team, some meetings will take place outside of regular work hours.

Benefits

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

This is a full-time remote position. Relocation assistance is not available for this role and compensation is competitive for the market the candidate is based in. Applicable benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, paid holidays and insurance will depend on the location of the selected candidate.

TO APPLY, TIMELINE, AND PROCESS

  • Submit your resume, cover letter and responses to our application questions.
  • Click the “Apply” button below to begin your application.
  • Interview process: Qualified applicants will participate in a series of interviews via Zoom. There will be 2-3 rounds of interviews.
  • Accommodation: If you require accommodations during the interview process, please contact us with your request.
